name: Maybank Marathon 2026
short_description: The Maybank Marathon 2026 is a full marathon held on August 23, 2026, in Gianyar, Bali, Indonesia.
ai_summary: The Maybank Marathon 2026 is a full marathon scheduled for August 23, 2026, based at the Bali United Training Center in Gianyar, Bali, Indonesia. The event offers three distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, and 10km, catering to a range of runner abilities, alongside wheelchair and children's sprint categories. It is Indonesia's first World Athletics Elite Label road race. Registration closed on 22 February 2026.

excerpt_quotes.quote: The Maybank Marathon route, as always, was both breathtaking and challenging.

research_highlights: Marathon start is around 4:30 AM to let runners catch the sunrise and avoid the worst of the day's heat before humidity sets in.

Course winds through Balinese villages, rice paddies and rural roads in Gianyar Regency, with earlier full-marathon editions starting near Bali Safari Park before the first 10km along a dual carriageway toward Sanur.
It is Indonesia's only World Athletics 'Elite Label' road race and has been in the Boston Marathon qualifying directory since 2013, so timing/certification is taken seriously.
Route support includes marshals in traditional Balinese dress, gamelan orchestras and cultural performances along the way, a signature feature reviewers repeatedly mention.
August in Gianyar typically runs 22-29°C with moderate humidity and minimal rainfall, per race-guide temperature data for the event.
research_watchouts: Some editions have introduced tougher, hillier reroutes where 'there were plenty of instances where runners would rather walk than run the uphill portion' according to a 2017 participant recap.
Despite the early start, humidity builds quickly after sunrise — organisers themselves have publicly acknowledged Bali's hot, humid conditions when discussing race planning.
Slots reportedly sell out fast each year, so late registration can mean missing your preferred distance category.
Logistics for race-pack collection and transfers to the start (particularly for the full marathon) require planning, as some editions have used shuttle buses from a separate start point.

faqs.question: When is the Maybank Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Maybank Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 23, 2026. This date marks the event's main race day, and it is held at the Bali United Training Center in Gianyar, Bali, Indonesia, offering runners multiple distance categories to choose from.

faqs.question: Where is the Maybank Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race is held at the Bali United Training Center, located in Gianyar, Bali, Indonesia. This venue serves as the base for the event, which includes a full marathon, half marathon, and 10km race option for participants.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Maybank Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Registration for the 2026 edition has closed. A pre-sale ran for Maybank customers from 9 to 30 January 2026, followed by public registration from 9 to 22 February 2026. Runners hoping to take part should watch for the 2027 entry windows, which typically open in January.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Maybank Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Maybank Marathon 2026 offers three distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, and a shorter 10km race. This range allows both experienced marathoners and newer runners to participate in the event.
